Title: Start/Stop VMs during off-hours in Azure Automation has been updated

Body.Content:
The update to this Azure Marketplace solution includes:

  • Email functionality now uses Azure alerts and action groups. SendGrid is no longer part of the solution.
  • All dependent modules have been upgraded to the latest version.
  • Runbooks have been refactored to remove legacy cmdlets. 

For more information, please see Start/Stop VMs during off-hours in Azure Automation product documentation.
